BARRAGE - PIXEL CONQUEST

Update Log & Feature List (2026-09-27)

FEATURE EXCLUSIVES & MODS





Core Warfare & Arsenal Mods:





Locked Arsenal: Unlocks artillery, airfields, railguns, mega nukes, scattershots, and reinforcements without purchasing their passes.



Hidden Warheads: Enables the normally unavailable H-Bomb and MIRV warheads.



Free Counter-Attacks: Cancels incoming attacks troop-for-troop, allowing border attacks to be stopped for minimal losses.



Bot Alliances: Allows alliances with bots that the normal game menu does not expose.

MATCHMAKING & MATCH FLOW





Auto Queue:





Auto Queue: Automatically finds and joins matches using Presets (Soonest Match, Skirmish, Solo, World War), selectable Room Size (Any Size, Battle, Skirmish, Solo, World War), and Queue Actions (Claim Free Reward, Skip Historical, Skip Special Modes), with a configurable Queue Delay.



Solo Mode: Creates your own private room populated only by bots. If you own the Host pass, Solo also starts with x4 troops and 100k gold.



Auto Spawn:





Auto Spawn: Automatically selects your starting position using configurable Spawn Priorities (Coast, Far From Players, Flat Terrain, Open Land) and an adjustable Pick Delay.



Match End:





Match End: Automatically handles completed or lost matches using End Actions (Leave After Match, Leave When Defeated) and a configurable Leave Delay.

WAR & EXPANSION AUTOMATION





Auto Expand:





Auto Expand: Automatically expands your empire with keybind support using selectable Expand Targets (Bots, Finish Weak Empires, Naval Landings, Open Land, Players), configurable Keep Troops, and Attack Strength.



Smart Targeting: Scores targets using the game’s own battle calculations, avoids borders protected by defense posts, prioritizes finishing empires below 100 tiles, and keeps enough troops in reserve to reduce bot aggression.



Auto Defense:





Auto Defense: Automatically protects your borders using Defense Actions (Counter Attacks, Defense Posts, Reinforce) with a configurable Post Threat threshold.

WEAPONS & STRIKES





Auto Strikes:





Auto Strikes: Automatically uses strategic weapons with selectable Strike Weapons (Airstrikes, Railguns), configurable Strike Target, and Min Target Army. Enemy defense posts threatening your border are prioritized first.



Auto Nuke:





Auto Nuke: Automatically launches nuclear weapons using selectable Warheads (Atom Bomb, H-Bomb, MIRV, Mega Nuke, Scattershot), configurable Nuke Target, and a Gold Reserve.

ECONOMY & BUILDING





Auto Build:





Auto Build: Automatically develops your empire with keybind support using Build Actions (Airfields, Anti-Nuke, Artillery, Cities, Ports, Railguns), configurable City Plan, Max City Level, and Gold Reserve.



Smart Saving: Automatically pauses spending when Auto Nuke has a worthwhile target and needs gold reserved for the strike.



Auto Shop:





Auto Shop: Automatically purchases supported passes and perk patterns using in-game Money, with selectable Shop Items and a configurable Money Reserve.

DIPLOMACY





Auto Alliances:





Auto Alliances: Automatically manages diplomatic requests using configurable Alliance Actions (Accept All/Stronger, Ally Bots Early, Ally Stronger Neighbours, Decline All/Weaker, Renew All/Stronger) and an adjustable Strength Ratio.
